Load a paper corpus

Source: R/import-papers.R
papers_load.Rd

Downloads a paper corpus RDS file from the scienceverse/papers GitHub repository and loads it into R as a paperlist object. By default the file is downloaded to a temporary location and discarded after loading, which is the right choice for one-off use. Set cache = TRUE to save it permanently in the user data directory instead, so subsequent calls reuse the cached copy rather than re-downloading. Use papers_remove() to delete a cached corpus.

Usage

papers_load(
  name,
  repo = "scienceverse/papers",
  cache = FALSE,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

name

name of the corpus, without the .rds extension (see papers_available())

repo

GitHub repository in "owner/repo" format

cache

whether to save the corpus to the user data directory for reuse across sessions, instead of downloading it fresh each time

overwrite

whether to re-download if already cached (only relevant when cache = TRUE)

Value

a paperlist object

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
collabra <- papers_load("collabra")
} # }
